---
name: Bug report
about: Something wrong in one of the games
title: "[Game] Short description"
labels: bug
---

**Game:** <!-- e.g. Mario Kart 64 -->

**Build:** <!-- the date or version of the zip you installed, if you know it -->

**OS and version:** <!-- e.g. Onion 4.3.1, MinUI 2024.12, spruce 3.x, Allium, stock OS -->

**Device:** <!-- Miyoo Mini, Mini Plus, Mini v4 or Mini Flip -->

**Started from:** <!-- Apps, Ports, the MinUI home screen ... -->

**What happened:**

<!-- What you did, what you expected, and what you saw instead. Screenshots or a photo help. -->

**Can you make it happen again?** <!-- always / sometimes / once -->

**Log:**

Please attach `console.log` from the game's data folder, `App/<Game>/data/console.log`
(Mario Kart 64: `App/MarioKart64/console.log`), copied off the SD card right after the problem,
before you start the game again. If the game didn't start at all, attach `launch.log` and
`games_launch.log` from the same folder instead.

<!-- Please don't attach your ROM, a save state, or any zip with "PERSONAL" in its name: they contain game data. -->
